name: expand-button
title: ExpandButton
description: The chevron that opens and closes a row or a panel, with the rotation and the aria-expanded wiring already done. Copy: the label names what opens, not the direction — "Show the transcript", not "Expand".
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/ExpandButton.json
